name: Searchable Media Memory
description: Turn Shock's Art media into a searchable memory that can retrieve useful footage by meaning across visual and language evidence, including silent footage.
goal: Searching a canonical concept such as Dragon Staff returns named livestream moments, related visual moments, and visually matching silent footage with inspectable provenance.

executionLegend.github: Can be implemented remotely as repository code/config/tests.
executionLegend.codex: Requires execution on the actual Windows workstation, local files, GPU/CUDA, private credentials, or performance measurement.
executionLegend.both: Repository work plus definitive on-machine validation/calibration.

knowns.title: Architecture
knowns.detail: The indexing model is Media -> Traces -> Associations -> Entities.

knowns.title: Media foundation exists
knowns.detail: Generic Media records, local scanning, hashing, deduplication, and FFprobe metadata already exist.

knowns.title: Validation corpus is provisional
knowns.detail: The original planned proof corpus was 14 items (7 videos and 7 images, including a roughly 5 GB source), but the main/original footage is currently unavailable. A clip-heavy set that is available locally is being used as the provisional validation corpus; recovering the originals is useful later but does not block the indexing prototype.

knowns.title: Evaluation isolation
knowns.detail: Filename, path, and filename-derived title must not influence semantic retrieval scores.

knowns.title: Local-first inference
knowns.detail: Bulk indexing should run locally on the RTX 3060 12 GB workstation; Gemini remains fallback/escalation rather than the bulk indexer.

knowns.title: Archive direction
knowns.detail: Private YouTube is the intended long-term source/archive layer; local source media should be temporary or externally owned rather than permanently mirrored by Library.

knowns.title: Clips remains distinct
knowns.detail: Editorial clip ranking and semantic retrieval are separate concerns and must retain separate scores.

knowns.title: SQLite is sufficient for prototype
knowns.detail: Start with SQLite and brute-force normalized-vector search; add vector infrastructure only after measured need.

knowns.title: Prototype must not depend on one fixed fixture
knowns.detail: Trace extraction and semantic retrieval should work against any representative local validation set. Exact 14/7/7 counts are no longer a product requirement; the actual available corpus is inventoried and used for current validation.

knowns.title: Observed provisional corpus inventory
knowns.detail: The current local validation source contains 14 files: 6 video and 8 image. Checksum deduplication correctly collapses two duplicate files, producing 12 unique Media records: 5 video and 7 image.

knowns.title: Provisional corpus validation passed
knowns.detail: On 2026-08-17 the second ingest created 0, updated 0, skipped all 14 source files, and reported 0 errors; all 12 unique Media records had credible metadata. The largest current source is 20240821_094033.mp4 at 247,716,169 bytes and 32.206244 seconds; SHA-256 took about 0.277 seconds and ffprobe about 0.043 seconds. Long-form performance remains deferred.

knowns.title: Visual Trace implementation foundation exists
knowns.detail: Trace, Embedding, and IndexRun schemas plus a standalone restart-safe visual extraction service/CLI are implemented. The baseline creates one Trace per still and five-second sparse video samples into generated Library index artifacts; real-machine extraction performance and sampling calibration remain IDX-012/IDX-013.

unknowns.title: Qwen workstation fit
unknowns.detail: Peak VRAM, throughput, batch size, quantization need, and Python/CUDA compatibility for the selected multimodal embedding model are not yet measured.

unknowns.title: Embedding dimension
unknowns.detail: The best retrieval/storage tradeoff among reduced and full embedding dimensions is unknown.

unknowns.title: Visual sampling cadence
unknowns.detail: The optimal sparse frame interval and value of scene-change sampling vary by short B-roll versus long livestreams.

unknowns.title: Whisper configuration
unknowns.detail: The best local speech model and GPU configuration for creator speech and unusual project names is unknown.

unknowns.title: Association threshold
unknowns.detail: A reliable same-object/project similarity threshold must be derived from labeled examples, not guessed.

unknowns.title: Private YouTube retrieval
unknowns.detail: Authenticated private-video access, range retrieval reliability, throttling, and practical download throughput require workstation/account testing.

unknowns.title: Vector scaling threshold
unknowns.detail: The point at which SQLite brute-force similarity becomes too slow is unknown and should be measured on real Trace volume before adding a vector database.

unknowns.title: Media relocation frequency
unknowns.detail: If local files are frequently renamed or moved, path-based source identity may eventually need a MediaLocation abstraction; do not redesign until observed.

unknowns.title: Original long-form validation footage availability
unknowns.detail: The main/original footage from the initially planned validation set is currently missing. Continue with available clips; revisit long-form-specific benchmarks when a representative source becomes available.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: Establish the existing Media and operational base.

phases.name: Corpus readiness
phases.goal: Prove the currently available validation media is cleanly, observably, and repeatably represented without requiring the missing original footage.

phases.name: Visual Trace foundation
phases.goal: Represent inspectable visual moments without ML coupling.

phases.name: Local multimodal runtime
phases.goal: Prove a safe local embedding runtime on the workstation.

phases.name: Semantic visual search
phases.goal: Retrieve correct visual moments without filename leakage.

phases.name: Language Traces
phases.goal: Add timestamped language evidence from existing transcripts and local transcription.

phases.name: Associations
phases.goal: Bridge language-rich and silent media with evidence-backed links.

phases.name: Entities
phases.goal: Resolve recurring concepts/objects into canonical searchable entities.

phases.name: Generalized retrieval and YouTube
phases.goal: Index externally archived media without building a permanent local mirror.

phases.name: Indexer operations
phases.goal: Make indexing resumable, observable, and safe for long-running use.

phases.name: Creator workflow
phases.goal: Turn retrieval into a practical Find -> Judge -> Pull -> Edit flow.

milestones.name: Foundation present
acceptance: Generic Media model exists.
Local ingest is idempotent and deduplicates.
Library catalog exists.
JARVIS lifecycle/health contract is operational.

milestones.name: Corpus ready
acceptance: All currently available validation source files are visible to the scanner and inventoried.
Source-file counts and checksum-distinct Media counts are both recorded.
Metadata is credible.
Repeat ingest creates no new Media records.
Missing original/main footage is documented but does not block prototype work.

milestones.name: Visual Traces ready
acceptance: Every corpus item has inspectable visual Traces.
Video sampling does not explode into redundant frames.
Extraction is restart-safe.

milestones.name: Embedding runtime ready
acceptance: Selected multimodal model repeatedly encodes images/frames and text on the workstation.
Web server does not require or load the GPU stack.
Working dependency versions are documented/pinned.

milestones.name: True visual indexing proof
acceptance: Representative semantic queries rank correct media and useful moments near the top.
Filename/path/title do not influence the semantic score.
Top matches can be refined to more precise timestamps.

milestones.name: Language retrieval ready
acceptance: Timestamped language Traces are searchable.
Existing transcripts are reused where available.
Local transcription fallback has acceptable names/timestamps.

milestones.name: Cross-modal association proof
acceptance: Named/spoken visual evidence can surface genuinely related silent footage.
Association provenance and confidence are inspectable.
Automatic propagation is limited to one hop initially.

milestones.name: Dragon Staff proof
acceptance: Searching Dragon Staff returns named footage, nearby visual evidence, and matching silent footage.
Entity aliases/evidence are reviewable and correctable.

milestones.name: External archive integration
acceptance: Local and YouTube media use a shared retrieval interface.
Private YouTube access works without committing credentials.
Temporary source material is cleaned after indexing.

milestones.name: Operational indexer
acceptance: Index jobs are resumable/retriable.
A failed GPU/index job cannot take down the web app.
Long-running soak/restart behavior is acceptable.

milestones.name: Creator workflow proof
acceptance: Shock can search, judge a moment, and pull/open useful source footage without knowing the original filename/date/source.
The workflow is practical on mobile as well as desktop.

items.title: Persist generic Media records
acceptance: Media records support local image/video identity and metadata.

items.title: Implement idempotent local media ingestion
acceptance: Repeat scans skip unchanged files and duplicate content.

items.title: Expose real Library catalog and ingest action
acceptance: /library renders persisted Media and can trigger a scan.

items.title: Standardize JARVIS lifecycle and health foundation
acceptance: Standard Start/Stop/Restart/Update contract and namespaced health are available.

items.title: Add ingestion diagnostics and machine-readable Media inventory
acceptance: Ingest failures expose file and reason.
Inventory exposes Media ID, kind, duration, dimensions, size, processing status, and abbreviated hash.

items.title: Load the available clip-heavy validation corpus into the configured Library source
acceptance: All currently available validation clips/images are visible to the local scanner.
Actual file/video/image counts are recorded.
Source files are not renamed, transcoded, or modified.
Missing original/main footage is explicitly noted and is nonblocking.
evidence: Local validation 2026-08-17: data/library_inbox contains 14 supported source files (6 video, 8 image); scanner sees all 14; ingest produced 12 unique Media records after skipping 2 checksum duplicates (5 video, 7 image); git worktree remained clean.

items.title: Validate available corpus metadata, idempotence, and representative file costs
acceptance: Source-file counts and checksum-distinct Media counts are both recorded; duplicate source files are expected to collapse rather than count as missing Media.
Current expected inventory is 14 source files (6 video, 8 image) producing 12 unique Media records (5 video, 7 image) unless the local corpus changes before validation.
Video/image durations, dimensions, sizes, and processing statuses are recorded and credible.
A second ingest creates zero new Media records and reports the existing/duplicate files as skipped.

Hash/probe time is measured on the largest currently available source; if no representative long/large source is available, that benchmark is explicitly deferred to IDX-012 or the first suitable source.
evidence: Local validation 2026-08-17: 14 source files -> 12 unique Media (5 video, 7 image); second ingest created 0, updated 0, skipped 14, errors 0; metadata valid with no problems; largest source 20240821_094033.mp4 is 247,716,169 bytes / 32.206244s; SHA-256 0.276637s; ffprobe 0.043019s; long-form benchmark deferred.

items.title: Add Trace schema for timestamped extracted evidence
acceptance: Trace supports media_id, type, time range, text/artifact provenance, extractor version, confidence, and metadata.
evidence: app/library_models.py: Trace includes Media FK, extensible trace_type, millisecond range, content/artifact, extractor/version/configuration identity, confidence, provenance/metadata, constraints, and restart-safe extraction uniqueness.

items.title: Add Embedding and IndexRun schemas
acceptance: Embeddings record model ID, dimension, dtype, normalization, and vector bytes.
IndexRun records stage, configuration hash, status, timing, error, and statistics.
evidence: app/library_models.py: Embedding and IndexRun models with relationships/constraints/indexes.

items.title: Add indexing CLI/service boundary with deterministic fake backend tests
acceptance: Indexing can run outside FastAPI.
Unit tests do not require GPU/model downloads.
Indexing stages can be resumed safely.
evidence: app/indexing/__main__.py provides status, index-media, and index-pending without importing FastAPI.
app/indexing/service.py persists progress per Trace and resumes/reuses completed timestamps.
tests/test_indexing.py uses a deterministic fake frame backend and covers interrupted-run resume without FFmpeg/GPU/model downloads.

items.title: Implement still/video visual Trace extraction and generated thumbnail artifacts
acceptance: Still images yield one visual Trace.
Videos yield timestamped visual Traces.
Generated artifacts are Git-ignored and reproducible.
evidence: app/indexing/service.py implements FFmpeg still extraction and baseline five-second sparse video sampling into data/library_index generation paths.
Trace identity includes extractor/version/configuration; reruns reuse valid artifacts and repair missing artifacts without duplicate rows.
tests/test_indexing.py covers still, sparse video, reuse, resume, and repair behavior.

items.title: Benchmark sparse FFmpeg extraction on short, long, and large sources
acceptance: Record extraction time, frame count, scratch use, and failure behavior on representative media; if original long-form footage is still unavailable, use the largest suitable source available and revisit when long-form media arrives.

items.title: Tune and encode adaptive sampling policy
acceptance: Sampling works for short B-roll and long livestreams without excessive near-duplicates.
Policy is configuration-driven and tested.

items.title: Implement lazy multimodal EmbeddingBackend abstraction
acceptance: FastAPI imports/startup do not import the ML stack.
Backend supports text and image embedding with explicit model ID/dimension.

items.title: Audit workstation Python, NVIDIA driver, CUDA, VRAM, and installed ML runtime
acceptance: Environment report records versions and CUDA availability without destructive upgrades.

items.title: Install and benchmark candidate Qwen multimodal embedding runtime
acceptance: Encode one text query and representative image batches.
Record model-load time, throughput, idle/peak VRAM, batch limit, and OOM behavior.
Compare practical embedding dimensions.

items.title: Pin and document the validated indexing environment
acceptance: Working versions/configuration are encoded in repository docs/dependencies.
Indexing-unavailable errors are graceful.

items.title: Generate and persist normalized visual Trace embeddings
acceptance: Visual Trace embeddings can be regenerated deterministically by model/config version.
Different model generations are never silently mixed.

items.title: Implement SQLite-backed brute-force cosine retrieval with timing instrumentation
acceptance: Normalized-vector search returns deterministic top-K results.
Search latency and vector count are measurable.

items.title: Expose semantic visual search API and Library result presentation
acceptance: Results include Media, timestamp, thumbnail, score, and model/provenance.
Filename/title filter remains separate from semantic scoring.

items.title: Run representative semantic-query evaluation with filename leakage disabled
acceptance: Choose positive semantic queries based on concepts genuinely present in the available validation clips, plus absent-object controls.
Record ranking quality for multiple embedding dimensions/configurations.
Evaluation remains independent of filenames and can be repeated when the original corpus is recovered.

items.title: Add localized dense refinement around strong coarse video matches
acceptance: Strong coarse matches can be rescanned in a local time window for more precise timestamps.
Refinement improves usefulness without dense-indexing entire long videos.

items.title: Convert existing timestamped transcripts into Language Traces
acceptance: Existing transcript provenance/timestamps are preserved in the common Trace model.

items.title: Implement lazy local transcription backend interface
acceptance: Local speech transcription remains optional and isolated from FastAPI startup.

items.title: Benchmark local Whisper/faster-whisper configuration on creator speech
acceptance: Record runtime, VRAM, timestamp quality, general accuracy, and project/object-name accuracy.
Select the cheapest model/configuration that is good enough.

items.title: Implement hybrid language retrieval and fallback transcription flow
acceptance: Existing transcripts are preferred where available.
Untranscribed media can generate Language Traces locally.
Search exposes transcript evidence and provenance.

items.title: Create temporal Associations between nearby language and visual Traces
acceptance: Temporal links are configurable and preserve source/target Trace provenance.

items.title: Create cross-media visual-similarity Association candidates
acceptance: Named/anchored visual Traces can request nearest visual neighbors across Media.
Similarity score/model/provenance are persisted.

items.title: Build labeled association evaluation set and calibrate similarity threshold
acceptance: Label related/same-object and unrelated examples.
Choose threshold from observed score distributions rather than intuition.

items.title: Enforce one-hop automatic propagation and reviewable association state
acceptance: Automatic semantic propagation does not recursively chain beyond one hop.
Associations support accepted/rejected/unreviewed states.

items.title: Add Entity and EntityAlias schema
acceptance: Canonical entities can represent project/object/person/process/place/concept without a rigid required taxonomy.

items.title: Add admin entity/evidence review and correction tools
acceptance: Admin can create entities, add aliases, attach/detach evidence, and reject incorrect associations.

items.title: Fuse exact entity, language, visual, and association evidence in search
acceptance: Search preserves evidence provenance rather than collapsing all signals into an opaque score.

items.title: Run Dragon Staff cross-modal proof
acceptance: Dragon Staff search returns named/spoken footage, nearby visual evidence, and genuinely related silent footage.

items.title: Introduce MediaRetriever interface for materialize/range/cleanup lifecycle
acceptance: Indexer no longer assumes source bytes are permanently local.

items.title: Refactor shared yt-dlp/FFmpeg primitives without changing Clips behavior
acceptance: Clips regression tests remain green.
Library/indexer can reuse retrieval primitives with a different cache policy.

items.title: Implement local and private-YouTube MediaRetriever adapters
acceptance: YouTube Media can be represented/indexed without permanent source mirroring.
Credentials are never stored in Git.

items.title: Validate private YouTube authentication, throughput, and partial/range retrieval
acceptance: Private media metadata and bytes can be accessed locally.
Full-vs-range retrieval behavior is measured on representative sources.
Chosen fallback behavior is documented.

items.title: Implement scratch leases and cleanup for temporary source material
acceptance: Successful and failed jobs clean temporary media safely.
Persistent derived index artifacts remain separate from scratch.

items.title: Add persistent indexing job queue/state and singleton worker ownership
acceptance: GPU work executes outside FastAPI.
Jobs are resumable/retriable and stale worker ownership can be recovered.

items.title: Add Library indexing controls, progress, retry/cancel, and diagnostics
acceptance: Library can enqueue pending/reindex work and display stage/progress/errors without running inference in request handlers.

items.title: Run long-duration soak, restart/recovery, disk, and GPU contention tests
acceptance: Indexer survives restart/recovery scenarios.
Scratch cleanup works.
Web app remains responsive while indexing.
Observed vector-search latency is recorded at achieved Trace volume.

items.title: Integrate semantic result moments with source pull/open/editing actions
acceptance: A result can open surrounding footage or materialize useful source/range for editing without exposing storage complexity.

items.title: Validate Shock's Find -> Judge -> Pull -> Edit workflow on mobile and desktop
acceptance: A real user can retrieve and pull useful footage without knowing source filename, date, or stream.
Mobile flow is practical for Shock's normal usage.
